front.title: A YANG Data Model for Pre-Elimination Correlated Loss Matrix and Fate-Sharing OAM in Deterministic Networking (DetNet) PREOF

abstract.t: This document specifies a Standards Track YANG 1.1 data model (ietf- detnet-preof-loss-matrix) for reporting pre-elimination correlated packet delivery and co-failure outcomes across Deterministic Networking (DetNet) Packet Replication, Ordering, and Elimination Functions (PREOF). Against a closed source-declared packet population, the model classifies each original sequence number across paired replication branches into a 16-cell joint outcome matrix ({on- time, late, missing, indeterminate} x {Branch A, Branch B}) and four fate-sharing summary buckets (delivered-both, delivered-a-only, delivered-b-only, lost-both), enabling operators to distinguish masked single-branch drops from correlated dual-branch failures.
